production_contract.global_requirements:
JOAT ANIMATION STUDIO — STYLE 001

ONE MORE MESSAGE

90-SECOND CINEMATIC STORYTELLING PRODUCTION

DIRECTOR’S MISSION

Create one complete, emotionally engaging, premium-quality 90-second animated short using our existing Animation Studio infrastructure.

Use the storytelling structure established from our reference animation:

Emotional hook → Backstory → Conflict → Failed attempts → Discovery → Visual explanation → Transformation → Dramatic payoff.

This is a production execution assignment, not a request to redesign the studio.

Preserve existing characters, assets, agent hierarchy, and working integrations.

Use the Director → Executive → Supervisor → Worker production chain where operational.

Our objective is to validate a repeatable cinematic storytelling style that can be applied to future productions.

⸻

GLOBAL CINEMATIC REQUIREMENTS

Runtime: Exactly 90 seconds.

Aspect ratio: 9:16 vertical.

Target output: 1080 × 1920, 24 or 30 fps, subject to supported rendering and delivery capabilities.

Animation style: Premium stylized 3D realism with expressive characters, believable body movement, detailed environments, cinematic depth of field, and polished lighting.

Visual pacing: A new visual composition approximately every five seconds.

Character identity: Use existing approved character references and Face Master JSON assets where available. Do not redesign established characters.

Dialogue: Natural conversational delivery with synchronized mouth movement.

Narration: Warm, expressive, emotionally engaging voice.

Music: Continuous cinematic underscore that evolves with the emotional arc.

Captions: Bold, high-contrast, accurately synchronized captions placed within vertical-video safe areas.

Transitions: Motivated cuts, subtle camera movements, occasional cinematic transitions, and selective visual effects.

⸻

COMPLETE SCENE AND SHOT PLAN
